notes: The italicized *month* completes the substantival ordinal רִאשׁוֹן and joins its unit under rule 31 rather than standing added; the ASV italic corroborates without deciding, by rule 7.
לַחֹדֶשׁ is recast as the English genitive *of the month*, so the preposition takes the written *of* and the assimilated article the written *the*.
